admin.settingsDescription: Configure authentication, provider proxy, and transcoding.
admin.authSettingsDescription: These settings apply to all users on this server.
admin.networkSettingsDescription: Outbound HTTP/SOCKS proxy for metadata, poster, and subtitle providers only. Leave empty to use HTTPS_PROXY env or direct egress.
admin.proxyUrlDescription: Examples: http://127.0.0.1:7890 or socks5h://host.docker.internal:7890. Prefer socks5h so DNS goes through the proxy.
admin.proxyUrlTooltip:
http/https — HTTP CONNECT proxy.
socks5h — SOCKS5 with remote DNS (recommended).
socks5 — SOCKS5 with local DNS.
For VLESS/Reality: run sing-box/Xray with a local HTTP or SOCKS inbound; do not paste the VLESS URI here.
Inside Docker, 127.0.0.1 is the container — use host.docker.internal or the Compose service name.
admin.proxyPasswordStored: Password saved — leave blank to keep
admin.proxyPasswordDescription: Blank keeps the stored password when one already exists.
admin.noProxyDescription: Comma-separated hosts that bypass the proxy (e.g. localhost,127.0.0.1,.lan).
admin.transcodeSettingsDescription: Hardware encoder preference for HLS. Missing devices fall back to software.
admin.hwAccelDescription: Missing devices fall back to software (libx264).
admin.hwAccelTooltip:
Off — always libx264 (any host).
QSV — Intel only; preferred on Intel GPUs.
VA-API — Intel or AMD via /dev/dri.
NVENC — NVIDIA only.
Rockchip — arm64 RK3588-class with /dev/mpp_service.
admin.downmixAlgorithmHelp: How surround audio is mixed to stereo
admin.downmixAlgorithmDescription: Applies only when the source has more than two channels.
admin.downmixAlgorithmTooltip:
AC-4 — dialogue-aware surround→stereo (Jellyfin-style; default).
None — ffmpeg built-in -ac 2 matrix only (no gain boost).
admin.toneMappingEnabledHelp: Apply tone mapping when converting HDR/10-bit to SDR HLS
admin.toneMappingEnabledDescription: Off skips the TMO; source still transcodes to 8-bit SDR. Colors may look washed, crushed, or oversaturated.
admin.toneMappingEnabledTooltip:
On — apply a tone-mapping operator for HDR/wide-gamut/10-bit sources (default).
Off — scale/format only; no tonemap filter. Useful to compare color issues.
QSV uses software tonemapx so the selected algorithm is honored.
admin.toneMappingAlgorithmHelp: Operator used when tone mapping is enabled
admin.toneMappingAlgorithmDescription: Applies only when tone mapping is on and the source needs it.
admin.toneMappingAlgorithmTooltip:
bt2390 — ITU-R BT.2390 (default; Jellyfin-aligned).
hable — filmic Hable.
reinhard — Reinhard.
mobius — Mobius.
admin.dlnaSettingsDescription: LAN Media Server discovery (SSDP) and progressive play. Default off. Create a TV-role user and grant library read access first.
admin.dlnaUserDescription: Non-interactive principal used for ContentDirectory ACL. Cannot log into the web UI.
admin.dlnaPortHint: Ports/bind are env: SUDOSTREAM_DLNA_HTTP_PORT (8200), SUDOSTREAM_DLNA_HTTP_BIND, SUDOSTREAM_DLNA_SSDP_MULTICAST (239.255.255.250:1900), SUDOSTREAM_DLNA_ADVERTISE_HOST. LAN only; SSDP needs multicast (often host networking).
